Overview

Durban is a city in KwaZulu-Natal with a population of 3,442,000. A subtropical coastal city known for its golden beaches, Indian Ocean warmth, and rich Zulu heritage. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 280 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
